40 actual native tags; controller modes 0 MAN / 1 AUTO / 2 CAS
Process water feed flow controller mode [-]
Liquid balance residual, feeds minus product [m3/h]
Measured water to PO feed ratio [-]
PO conversion from analyzer and feed flows [%]
NATIVE CONTROL CONTRACT / EXACT PARAMETER REGISTER
TIC-201: PV source TI-201; MV TIC-201.OUT; mode AUTO; SP 60; reverse
Output cascades to TIC-202; remote-SP range is declared by the slave sp_limits.
TIC-202: PV source TI-202; MV TV-202; mode CAS; SP 48.955; direct
FIC-201: PV source FI-201; MV FV-201; mode AUTO; SP 2; reverse
FFC-202: PV source FI-202; MV FV-202; mode CAS; SP 7; reverse
Ratio feedforward: FI-201 x 3.5; mode CAS recomputes SP every scan.
LIC-201: PV source LI-201; MV LV-201; mode AUTO; SP 1.8; direct
R-201: PO2 + water7 m3/h; bulk60 degC; level1.8 m; jacket design SP computed from native equilibrium.
TT-201 = TI-201 source of TIC-201.PV; TT-202 = TI-202 source of TIC-202.PV, at jacket outlet.
FT-201 = FI-201 source of FIC-201.PV; FT-202 = FI-202 source of FFC-202.PV.
LT-201 = LI-201 source of LIC-201.PV; TI-204 is a separate thermowell, indication only.
FY is a conceptual ratio computation, not an additional historian tag; exact ratio_to source is FI-201.
Valve failures (*) are assumptions: feeds FC, cooling FO, product FL; no loss-of-air dynamics modelled.
Upstream feed pumps are outside the unit; both feeds enter above liquid; product drains under head.
Conceptual only: relief, isolation, vents, drains, line numbers, insulation and equipment sizing omitted.
